question: Who unfurls the flag at Rajpath on the Republic Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The President of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The President of India** unfurls the national flag at Rajpath on Republic Day.
 
• Republic Day is celebrated on **26th January** every year to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India.
 
• The event includes a grand parade showcasing India's defense capability, cultural and social heritage.
 
• It is one of the most significant national events in India, reflecting the country's unity and diversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **President of India** is the ceremonial head of state and the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The first Republic Day was celebrated on **26th January 1950**, the day the Constitution of India came into effect.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949**.
 
• Republic Day celebrations include the presentation of gallantry awards and the display of various cultural tableaux representing different states of India.
 
• The parade and celebrations are held in the national capital, New Delhi, and are attended by dignitaries from India and around the world.
